test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which year was the Marris College of Music established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1926.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This School was founded by **Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande in Lucknow.**
 
• Named after **Rai Umanath Bali** who was known as Marris.
 
• It became a University in 2000 and was **renamed as Bhatkhande Music Institute University**.
 
• This institute has been a significant center for **Hindustani Classical music.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kalakshetra Foundation (Chennai) was founded by Rukmini Devi Arundale in 1936.
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi (New Delhi) was founded in 1952**.
 
• Swarnabhoomi Academy of Music (Chennai) was founded in 2010.
 
• Prayaag Sangeet Samiti(Allahabad) was founded in 1926.
 
• Rabindra Bharti University(Kolkata) was founded in 1962.
 
• **Bhartiya Vidya Bhavan(Mumbai) was founded by K.M. Munshi in 1938**.
